item.description:
Set on an elevated allotment with sweeping harbour views and first time offered for sale since new, this is the rarest of opportunities to acquire a genuinely one-of-a-kind family residence by celebrated 20th-century architect Harry Seidler - all in one of Sydney's premier destinations.

An iconic example of Seidler's modernist genius and considerable influence, this remarkable triple-storey home has been recognised globally for its architectural significance and is living proof that outstanding design is absolutely timeless.

Characterised by its floor-to-ceiling windows, profusion of natural light and centrepiece circular staircase, the home's impressive interior showcases four main bedrooms (all large) each with its own walk-in robe and private ensuite.

Everyday family living is further enhanced by the inclusion of a dedicated study/home office, with separate level street access, along with adaptable open-design living and dining spaces all serviced by a well-appointed kitchen.

Head downstairs where the lower level serves as a self-contained apartment with its own street-level entrance complete with bedroom, bathroom, living area and galley kitchen - ideal for guests, extended family, teenage retreat or income stream.

Complementing the home's refined interior is a spacious backyard where extensive paving and 12.5 metre in-ground pool provide the perfect environment for relaxing or entertaining, plus the added advantage of an internally-accessed double garage and additional driveway parking.

FEATURES:
- In-floor heating
- Cross ventilation
- Granite benchtops and floors
- Solar power
- Three Tesla batteries
- 3-phase power
- Excellent storage solutions
- Large terrace from the living area
- Balcony from the master bedroom
- Established garden surrounds with automated water system and level access 
- Built-in gas line in the backyard, ready for easy barbecue connection
- Home office with its own private street access, featuring a wheelchair-accessible ramp entrance

LOCATION:
A short stroll to pristine harbour beaches, popular parks and Watsons Bay ferries direct to Circular Quay, this landmark residence is also close to village shops and restaurants, along with easy access to popular schools and sailing clubs.

INSPECT: 
By private appointment or as advertised.
